$comment: Template. Copy to {capability-slug}.json and replace values. Remove the $comment keys.
description: One paragraph describing what this capability does and why it exists.
outcomes: Outcome the capability must deliver for the organisation.
owned_data_domains: Named data domain owned by this capability (one or more databases/schemas).

market_context.competitive_landscape: Who provides this capability in the market. What is table stakes vs differentiator.
market_context.regulatory_horizon: Current and incoming regulation in the next 2-3 years.
market_context.build_vs_buy: Whether this organisation builds, buys, or partners — with rationale.
market_context.sub_capability_boundary_evidence: Market evidence used to support promotion decisions.
